An approved Clinical uniform: all students going to clinical will be required to purchase an EMT 100 T-shirt and have dark blue work pants; 3. Criminal background checks with drug screen; 4. Blood borne pathogens training; 5. Immunization verification; 6. A student must have the PPE, and other EMT equipment to participate in clinical hours. All of these requirements are a prerequisite for health and safety as mandated in Title 22, Division 9, Chapter 2 of the California Code of Regulations. Students must take EMT 115 in the same semester as EMT 116 and EMT 117 to meet clinical requirements to be successful in the program.
